description: This PHP class 'ResetPasswordService' provides functionalities for handling password reset workflows in the OrangeHRM system, including generating reset codes, sending reset emails, validating reset links, and updating passwords.

classes.name: ResetPasswordService
classes.description: Service class for managing password reset operations, including request validation, email notification, and password updates.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EmailService used for sending emails.

methods.name: getResetPasswordDao
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ResetPasswordDao used for database operations related to password reset requests.

methods.name: hasPasswordResetRequestNotExpired
methods.description: Calculates the number of days elapsed since the password reset request was made.

methods.name: extractPasswordResetMetaData
methods.description: Decodes the reset code and extracts username and other metadata embedded in it.

methods.name: generateEmailBody
methods.description: Generates email body content from a template file, replacing placeholders with actual values.

methods.name: searchForUserRecord
methods.description: Searches for a user by username, ensuring account is active and associated with an employee with a valid work email.

methods.name: generatePasswordResetEmailBody
methods.description: Constructs the email body content for the password reset email by including a reset link.

methods.name: sendPasswordResetCodeEmail
methods.description: Sends a password reset email to the employee's work email if valid.

methods.name: generatePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Creates a encoded reset code containing the username and secure random bytes.

methods.name: validateUser
methods.description: Validates that the user account is active and not associated with a terminated employee.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates password reset code URL, ensuring the code matches latest, is valid, and not expired.

methods.name: logPasswordResetRequest
methods.description: Logs a new password reset request, sends email, and stores request data.

methods.name: saveResetPassword
methods.description: Updates the user's password after validation, within a transaction.
